steps.speaker: Adelaide?
steps.content: Since when have you stopped calling me brother? That isn't very endearing of you.
The figure draws near. As a hand gently strokes her hair, a long-buried memory surfaces: this is how he comforted her, a lifetime ago.

steps.speaker: Adelaide?
steps.content: We are born into solitude. It is only with family that we can truly walk forward, side by side.

steps.speaker: Adelaide?
steps.content: You possess such extraordinary talent in Aurum Secretum. I wish for you to preserve this purity and excellence, to shine with peerless brilliance in your chosen field.

steps.speaker: Adelaide?
steps.content: Simply devote yourself to your cherished research. Do not trouble yourself with the origins of your materials, nor question how the fruits of your labor will be applied.
His voice holds the elegant depth of a cello and the cold warning of a serpent's hiss. Each syllable flicks against her nerves, chilling her to the bone.

steps.speaker: Adelaide?
steps.content: Those two little girls from DisCity... they sowed seeds of dissent in your heart and drove a wedge between us. You have witnessed the final outcome... those tormented souls... That is the consequence of your defiance.

steps.speaker: Adelaide?
steps.content: But regardless of your transgressions, I will always forgive you. I will help conceal them and make the necessary reparations. After all, we are family, the closest of kin.

steps.speaker: Adelaide?
steps.content: Come back, Hypa. You have wandered alone for far too long. Come back to my side. This is the only path you should choose, the only correct one.
A sensation of suffocation, inescapable and cold, claws its way up from the pit of her throat.
She staggers back. The nightmare only looms larger.
